pins.name: SCL
pins.notes: Pin 3 (TX/SCL). The sensor stretches the clock: use 50 kHz or less

pins.name: RDY
pins.notes: Pin 5. HIGH when a new reading is ready, optional

pins.name: SEL
pins.notes: Pin 7. Leave open or LOW for I2C; HIGH selects Modbus

sources.title: Sensirion SCD30 datasheet
sources.section: Pin 1 VDD, 2 GND, 3 TX/SCL, 4 RX/SDA, 5 RDY, 6 PWM, 7 SEL; supply 3.3 to 5.5 V

sources.title: Sensirion SCD30 interface description
sources.section: I2C address 0x61, max 100 kHz, clock stretching up to 150 ms
